title: Annoying bugs
body:
The pending tasks and reminders disappear suddenly. They come back after closing and opening the app again. The chat bot can create incorrect tasks sometimes.

Update after using it for 3 weeks
- the chatbot is too stupid to work with. Don’t buy the yearly subscription. Use it for a week to decide. I already cancelled.

Update after using it for more than a month
- few bugs were fixed, but another super annoying one was introduced. 
- I created a new reminder but it never showed up in the app, however got a notification. This app sometimes just add headache. 
- you guys are just messing up with your vibe-coding habits. Get a little serious and fix these obvious bugs. 
- Also, please refund my subscription cost.

title: Horrible app for Neurodivergent people
body: Firstly, inspite of subscribing twice to the pro version, it still kept me asking to subscribe. Secondly, to check that I tried to find the settings/profile icon, which usually is at the bottom right corner or the top left hamburger icon, this app didn't have neither of it. Instead it had a stupid AI button at the bottom right which didn't even knew where my profile was located in the app. After a frustrating and angry 10 mins and opening every icon, I found my profile at the fourth icon on the bottom menu bar, which had a fcin 'GRAPH' icon. Like seriously. How can an app have such horrible UX design. Please hire me. I can do better than this. Or atleast use the app yourselves first. I had bought a pro subscription for a year but I am uninstalling and will use some other app which doesn't frustrate uswrs within 5 mins of installing it
